title: Financial X-ray market research source registry
language: Arabic report; English concise source annotations
methodology: Primary public vendor sources accessed via live web search/open. No vendor outreach, customer files, authenticated trials, third-party price estimates or independent effectiveness verification.
scope_note: 25 core vendors/products plus one explicitly labeled Saudi CFO-services substitute. Missing evidence is not evidence of absence. Price and availability statements are limited to reviewed pages.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.supported_claim: Pro reporting, forecasting, consolidation and benchmarking; pricing by company count.
sources.caveat: Text includes AUD label and multiple-currency artifacts; numeric price not used as Saudi or USD quote.

sources.title: Get Started with the Analysis Tools
sources.supported_claim: Analysis tools cover financial and nonfinancial KPIs, profitability, cash flow and growth.
sources.caveat: Documentation, not an independent accuracy evaluation.

sources.title: Benchmark Divisions
sources.supported_claim: Explicitly states no external benchmarking data; benchmarks use entities in own Fathom account.
sources.caveat: This specific negative feature claim is directly documented; do not generalize it to other vendors.

sources.title: Fathom Tips: Investment Management
sources.supported_claim: Portfolio benchmarking segmentation and Commentary Writer using business/report context.
sources.caveat: Does not establish Saudi/Arabic support or evidence-based outcome closure.

sources.title: Pricing US Business
sources.supported_claim: USD35/month for one Business organization, excluding sales tax; reporting, forecasting, dashboard.
sources.caveat: US price page; not a Saudi quote, and not full service or implementation TCO.

sources.title: Advisors & Accountants
sources.supported_claim: Reporting, forecasts, dashboards, action planning and group benchmarking.
sources.caveat: Vendor product claims; no independent result validation.

sources.title: Action Plan
sources.supported_claim: AI-generated actions from executive summary; owner/team, due date, text and manually adjusted progress.
sources.caveat: Shows action tracking exists. Does not settle all evidence, approval or automatic outcome-verification capabilities.

sources.title: Benchmarks
sources.supported_claim: Benchmarks use anonymized connected-entity data with industry and country matching.
sources.caveat: Saudi cohort size, sampling, timeliness and commercial redistribution rights not verified.

sources.title: Financials
sources.supported_claim: Financial views across periods/entities/budgets, drill-down, AI insights and improvement suggestions.
sources.caveat: Support page product claims; did not test output quality.

sources.title: All about Review
sources.supported_claim: Review checks data quality, accounts, contacts, transactions and potential anomalies.
sources.caveat: Anomaly signals are not proof of fraud; local tax suitability not established.

sources.title: Pricing page
sources.supported_claim: Official URL was accessed, but returned no usable pricing body through research tool.
sources.caveat: No Syft numeric pricing claim is made.

sources.title: Insights
sources.supported_claim: Portfolio financial queries, client comparison, trends and advisory insights.
sources.caveat: Local module availability varies; no Saudi availability established.

sources.title: Silverfin Assistant
sources.supported_claim: Detects unusual balances/missing transactions/outliers; suggested fixes, approval and follow-up items.
sources.caveat: UK-oriented page; do not assume same localization or modules in Saudi Arabia.

sources.title: Collaboration
sources.supported_claim: Messaging, tasks and review integrated into workflows; auditable review trails described.
sources.caveat: Does not by itself prove realized-financial-benefit verification.

sources.title: General Ledger Analytics
sources.supported_claim: Transaction risk analytics over full accounting ledger with explainable risk signals.
sources.caveat: Vendor marketing assertions not independent proof of detection quality or fraud.

sources.title: Quick start: GL analysis
sources.supported_claim: Import files, verify account mapping, check completeness, run full-ledger analysis.
sources.caveat: Input-data depth and preparation required; not evidence that statements alone yield equivalent diagnosis.

sources.title: MindBridge score
sources.supported_claim: Risk scores combine configured control points.
sources.caveat: Risk scoring is not a final conclusion of misstatement or fraud.

sources.title: Datarails FP&A
sources.supported_claim: Excel-native consolidation, updated reports/models, dashboards, AI discrepancy/outlier/trend insights.
sources.caveat: No independent test of implementation time, Arabic reporting or closure.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.supported_claim: Customized quote by needs/users/integrations; plan inclusions described.
sources.caveat: No numeric price used; crawl/publication metadata inconsistent so do not infer publication date.

sources.title: Platform Overview
sources.supported_claim: Financial data, reporting, planning and AI through Excel, Sheets and collaborative interfaces.
sources.caveat: Plan-level availability and implementation scope require confirmation.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.supported_claim: Official page asks for custom quote; workflow/reporting and agent capabilities described.
sources.caveat: Older prices on third-party pages not used.

sources.title: Financial Planning & Analysis
sources.supported_claim: Planning, forecasting, variance and management reporting with Microsoft ecosystem and AI.
sources.caveat: No Saudi support/hosting conclusion drawn.

sources.title: Anomaly Detection & Predictive Forecasting
sources.supported_claim: Signals surfaces anomalies; Projections builds forecast baselines from patterns.
sources.caveat: Product names and features can change; no accuracy comparison conducted.

sources.title: Pigment AI documentation
sources.supported_claim: AI analysis, reporting and repeatable schedulable Missions.
sources.caveat: Docs preferred over old roadmap; availability of every agent must be checked separately.

sources.title: Finance Planning
sources.supported_claim: Financial planning, consolidation, reporting and opportunity/risk analysis.
sources.caveat: Enterprise suite scope; no implementation-cost assumption.

sources.title: Anaplan Intelligence
sources.supported_claim: Finance Analyst evaluates variances, forecasts, cost drivers and savings opportunities.
sources.caveat: No proof that opportunity claims are realized customer outcomes.

sources.title: AI for FP&A
sources.supported_claim: Adaptive Planning AI variance narratives, transaction drill-down and scenario exploration.
sources.caveat: No universal availability or local support assumed.

sources.title: Intelligence
sources.supported_claim: Data cleansing/anomalies, models, variance narratives, scenarios/goal-seek and task workflow.
sources.caveat: Workflow claims do not settle evidence-gated economic outcome closure.

sources.title: Platform
sources.supported_claim: Collaborative planning, financial reporting, summaries and workflows.
sources.caveat: No public current numeric price verified.

sources.title: Flux Analysis
sources.supported_claim: GL transaction detail supports driver-level variance analysis inside close.
sources.caveat: Not treated as a complete external benchmarking platform.

sources.title: Financial Close
sources.supported_claim: Reconciliation, consolidation, analysis, task management, control workflows and signoffs.
sources.caveat: Suite may require multiple modules; no one-plan equivalence assumed.

sources.title: Internal Audit Management
sources.supported_claim: Evidence-linked testing, report drafts, remediation/action suggestions and retained signoffs.
sources.caveat: Product claims; no conclusion that its standard implementation measures realized business benefit.

sources.title: Workiva for Audit Management support
sources.supported_claim: Audit management workspace/database includes requests, audits, data and remediation.
sources.caveat: Support architecture reinforces workflow scope; not independent validation.

sources.title: Internal Controls
sources.supported_claim: Controls/testing/evidence collection and remediation tracking with board/executive reporting.
sources.caveat: Control remediation differs from performance-opportunity realization.

sources.title: Board Reporting for Audit announcement
sources.supported_claim: Board dashboards cover open high/critical issues, impact and remediation status.
sources.caveat: Historical launch source; current product terms require validation.

sources.title: Agentic AI
sources.supported_claim: Audit agent described as drafting evidence requests, following up, escalating overdue items and assigning owners.
sources.caveat: Marketing page; confirm current availability and plan rather than assuming full autonomous closure.

sources.title: Industry Intelligence and Sector Data
sources.supported_claim: Capital IQ Pro standardized financials, sector metrics, peer benchmarking and public/private datasets.
sources.caveat: Coverage claims do not establish financial detail for every firm or rights to redistribute.

sources.title: Official site
sources.supported_claim: Financial/market benchmarks filter by industry, market and size; site references US businesses.
sources.caveat: US-focused data must not be presented as representative Saudi or universal global benchmark.

sources.title: Statement Studies
sources.supported_claim: Financial ratio benchmarks and industry/historical studies described.
sources.caveat: Reviewed page references 2024–2025 edition; displayed prices not represented as current 2026 prices.

sources.title: Open Standards Benchmarking
sources.supported_claim: Validated process performance measures with consistent definitions and industry/region/size peer groups.
sources.caveat: Operational measurements need data beyond financial statements; license not established.

sources.title: Core Accounting for Business Owners
sources.supported_claim: Saudi accounting software with trial balance, income statement, balance sheet and cash flow reports.
sources.caveat: Not claimed to be full independent diagnostic/closure competitor; regulatory claims not independently certified.

sources.title: API Integration
sources.supported_claim: Accounting resources, entries and invoices can feed custom analytics integrations.
sources.caveat: Specific endpoint completeness, access, history, limits and successful integration untested.

sources.title: Saudi Arabia product
sources.supported_claim: Saudi accounting/e-invoicing product with more than 40 financial reports and Arabic link.
sources.caveat: Vendor compliance claims not independently verified; not equated to full diagnostic product.

sources.title: Profit and Loss API
sources.supported_claim: P&L API supports dates, currency and filtering parameters.
sources.caveat: Does not establish all required GL/AR data endpoints or access permissions.

sources.title: Official Saudi ERP page
sources.supported_claim: Finance, operations, statements, cost centers, performance reporting and external integrations.
sources.caveat: Accounting/ERP adjacent substitute, not established as statements-upload diagnostic/closure product.

sources.title: Spend/Finance Suite
sources.supported_claim: Saudi business travel, expense reimbursements, invoice review and spending policies.
sources.caveat: Corporate card shown coming soon; no claim of full financial-statement diagnosis or benchmark engine.

sources.title: CFO Advisory in Saudi Arabia
sources.supported_claim: Service offers impact-ranked diagnostic, board packs, forecasts, scenarios and bilingual materials.
sources.caveat: Professional-service substitute, not SaaS; quality, outcomes and pricing unverified.
